source.quote_free_summary: An adjudicator must excuse themselves from a panel when an immediate-family or same-household member dances in a particular heat; "immediate family" is defined here by an enumerated list.

requirement: Block assignment/ballot where a declared or identity-detected conflict applies. Family and household are not detectable automatically; only declarations carry them.
